mut_brittle_bones.name: Brittle Bones
mut_brittle_bones.system.description:
Mutilation of rank 2. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The bone thins from within and rings when struck.

Effect: the bearer takes 10% more slashing, piercing, and bludgeoning damage (negative DR = vulnerability).

Removal: mutilations inflicted by Biomancy can't be healed with potions and don't pass with rest. They can be removed only by Biomancy's own healing magic or by dispelling (the dispeller doctrine isn't defined yet; placeholder).

mut_cataract.name: Cataract
mut_cataract.system.description:
Mutilation of rank 1. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The cornea clouds over with a milky film, and the eye waters.

Effect: −2 to Perception and to all ranged attacks.

Removal: mutilations inflicted by Biomancy can't be healed with potions and don't pass with rest. They can be removed only by Biomancy's own healing magic or by dispelling (the dispeller doctrine isn't defined yet; placeholder).

mut_extra_arm.name: Extra Arm
mut_extra_arm.system.description:
Mutilation of rank 3. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

A third arm breaks out from under a rib. It doesn't obey and grabs at whatever the bearer is fighting with.

Effect: −2 to all melee attacks.

Removal: mutilations inflicted by Biomancy can't be healed with potions and don't pass with rest. They can be removed only by Biomancy's own healing magic or by dispelling (the dispeller doctrine isn't defined yet; placeholder).

mut_flesh_rejection.name: Flesh Rejection
mut_flesh_rejection.system.description:
Mutilation of rank 5. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The body stops recognizing itself and starts consuming its own tissue.

Effect: 3 damage at the start of their turn. While the mutilation lasts, the bearer cannot regain HP by any means. The healing ban isn't automated; the GM enforces it.

Removal: mutilations inflicted by Biomancy can't be healed with potions and don't pass with rest. They can be removed only by Biomancy's own healing magic or by dispelling (the dispeller doctrine isn't defined yet; placeholder).

mut_flooded_lungs.name: Flooded Lungs
mut_flooded_lungs.system.description:
Mutilation of rank 4. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The lungs swell and fill with their own fluid: the bearer drowns from within.

Effect: at the start of each of their turns, the bearer gains a stack of the Suffocating condition. Stack accumulation isn't automated; the GM adds them through the status HUD.

Removal: mutilations inflicted by Biomancy can't be healed with potions and don't pass with rest. They can be removed only by Biomancy's own healing magic or by dispelling (the dispeller doctrine isn't defined yet; placeholder).

mut_frailty_con.name: Weakness: Constitution
mut_frailty_con.system.description:
What others shrug off knocks you down: a draft, bad water, a second sleepless night.

Effect: −1 Constitution rank. HP, Universal AP, and carry capacity drop along with it.

Congenital Flaw. Taken at character creation and grants +1 Mutation Point (no more than two flaws). Permanent: it can't be healed, isn't removed by rest, can't be bought off with experience, and can't be undone by Biomancy; it is part of the body's template.

mut_frailty_dex.name: Weakness: Dexterity
mut_frailty_dex.system.description:
The body lets you down in small things: fingers miss the clasp, a foot catches the threshold, balance has to be caught all over again.

Effect: −1 Dexterity rank. Dodge, Speed, and the Maneuver AP pool drop along with it.

Congenital Flaw. Taken at character creation and grants +1 Mutation Point (no more than two flaws). Permanent: it can't be healed, isn't removed by rest, can't be bought off with experience, and can't be undone by Biomancy; it is part of the body's template.

mut_frailty_rea.name: Weakness: Reaction
mut_frailty_rea.system.description:
You see everything in time and understand it all correctly; your hand just gets there half a step later than it should.

Effect: −1 Reaction rank. Block and Dodge (Reaction counts at half in them), Initiative, and the Maneuver AP pool drop along with it.

Congenital Flaw. Taken at character creation and grants +1 Mutation Point (no more than two flaws). Permanent: it can't be healed, isn't removed by rest, can't be bought off with experience, and can't be undone by Biomancy; it is part of the body's template.

mut_frailty_str.name: Weakness: Strength
mut_frailty_str.system.description:
The muscle won't build however much you load it: the hilt grows heavy by mid-fight, a sack has to be dragged.

Effect: −1 Strength rank. Block, carry capacity, and the Maneuver AP pool drop along with it.

Congenital Flaw. Taken at character creation and grants +1 Mutation Point (no more than two flaws). Permanent: it can't be healed, isn't removed by rest, can't be bought off with experience, and can't be undone by Biomancy; it is part of the body's template.

mut_fused_fingers.name: Fused Fingers
mut_fused_fingers.system.description:
Mutilation of rank 4. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The fingers fuse with webbing into a stiff flipper.

Effect: −2 to all attacks; a two-handed grip is impossible while the mutilation lasts. The grip ban isn't automated; the GM enforces it.

Removal: mutilations inflicted by Biomancy can't be healed with potions and don't pass with rest. They can be removed only by Biomancy's own healing magic or by dispelling (the dispeller doctrine isn't defined yet; placeholder).

mut_hideous.name: Disfigurement
mut_hideous.system.description:
The face is put together wrong, and it's the first thing people notice.

Effect: −2 to Persuasion and Performance. People remember your face: any attempt to go unrecognized in a crowded place is harder.

Congenital Flaw. Taken at character creation and grants +1 Mutation Point (no more than two flaws). Permanent: it can't be healed, isn't removed by rest, can't be bought off with experience, and can't be undone by Biomancy; it is part of the body's template.

mut_ill_humours.name: Bad Blood
mut_ill_humours.system.description:
Your blood takes poorly to anything foreign: a draught spreads through the body at half strength and fades fast.

Effect: potions work on you at half strength: healing, bonuses, and durations are halved, rounded down. Poisons work at full strength.

Not automated: the system doesn't interfere with potion calculations; the GM works out the half.

Congenital Flaw. Taken at character creation and grants +1 Mutation Point (no more than two flaws). Permanent: it can't be healed, isn't removed by rest, can't be bought off with experience, and can't be undone by Biomancy; it is part of the body's template.

mut_photophobia.name: Light Sensitivity
mut_photophobia.system.description:
The eye can't take bright light: tears, stinging, everything blurs.

Effect: in bright light (daytime in the open, a torch in the face) −2 to attacks and Perception.

Not automated: the system doesn't track lighting; the GM applies the penalty.

Congenital Flaw. Taken at character creation and grants +1 Mutation Point (no more than two flaws). Permanent: it can't be healed, isn't removed by rest, can't be bought off with experience, and can't be undone by Biomancy; it is part of the body's template.

mut_restless.name: Restless Sleep
mut_restless.system.description:
You can't drop off for half an hour: the body won't let go, the head won't switch off.

Effect: a Short Rest restores nothing for you. Only a Long Rest puts you back in order.

Not automated: the system calculates rest as usual; the GM enforces the skipped recovery.

Congenital Flaw. Taken at character creation and grants +1 Mutation Point (no more than two flaws). Permanent: it can't be healed, isn't removed by rest, can't be bought off with experience, and can't be undone by Biomancy; it is part of the body's template.

mut_sagging_skin.name: Sagging Skin
mut_sagging_skin.system.description:
Mutilation of rank 1. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The skin pulls away from the muscle and hangs in folds, hampering arm movement.

Effect: −2 to Block.

Removal: mutilations inflicted by Biomancy can't be healed with potions and don't pass with rest. They can be removed only by Biomancy's own healing magic or by dispelling (the dispeller doctrine isn't defined yet; placeholder).

mut_shortness_of_breath.name: Shortness of Breath
mut_shortness_of_breath.system.description:
Your chest works hard and loud; on any climb you fall behind.

Effect: Speed −4 m. Any sustained exertion (running, a long climb, rowing) requires a Constitution check where others pass without a roll.

Congenital Flaw. Taken at character creation and grants +1 Mutation Point (no more than two flaws). Permanent: it can't be healed, isn't removed by rest, can't be bought off with experience, and can't be undone by Biomancy; it is part of the body's template.

mut_stunted_tail.name: Stunted Tail
mut_stunted_tail.system.description:
Mutilation of rank 2. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

A short hairless stub pushes out of the tailbone. It can't hold anything, but it sways and throws off balance.

Effect: −2 to Dodge and Athletics.

Removal: mutilations inflicted by Biomancy can't be healed with potions and don't pass with rest. They can be removed only by Biomancy's own healing magic or by dispelling (the dispeller doctrine isn't defined yet; placeholder).

mut_swollen_joints.name: Swollen Joints
mut_swollen_joints.system.description:
Mutilation of rank 3. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

Knees and ankles swell up; the joint moves with crunching and pain.

Effect: Speed is halved.

Removal: mutilations inflicted by Biomancy can't be healed with potions and don't pass with rest. They can be removed only by Biomancy's own healing magic or by dispelling (the dispeller doctrine isn't defined yet; placeholder).
